$comment: Permissions.allow block for a PUBLIC repo that /mission drains (VOY-1807, parent VOY-1801).
Merge this into the repo's TRACKED .claude/settings.json. It is the private template
The MCP grants live at the USER level, in ~/.claude/settings.json of whichever machine or
environment runs missions: the mcp__claude_ai_Linear__*, mcp__claude_ai_Notion__* and
mcp__claude_ai_Slack__* entries from templates/claude-settings-permissions.json. A public repo
should not publish which connectors and tools the team's missions use.
Check a repo against it with: node scripts/mission-preflight.mjs --grants --repo <path>
That gate reads the repo's settings.json, settings.local.json and the user-level file, and
fails when an MCP grant is in none of them.
Print this block for pasting with: node scripts/mission-preflight.mjs --grants --print --public
Headless Claude ignores a project's settings.json in a folder it has not trusted, and trust is
per folder. User-level settings apply everywhere, so the MCP grants there are not affected.
